melder.crystallizer.crystal_analysis.mod.label: module_answer_cache
melder.crystallizer.crystal_analysis.mod.role: Process-wide, guarded, value-only answers about modules that crystal analyses reuse across binds (#331).
responsibilities: declare the value shapes kept per module: path, custody kind, walk facts, resolved roots, provenance
keep answers reusable only while their inputs are unchanged, so a warm analysis is lookups plus one stat per physical module

melder.crystallizer.crystal_analysis.mod.label: ModuleAnswerCache
melder.crystallizer.crystal_analysis.mod.role: Class-hosted cache of the answers a CrystalAnalyzer would otherwise recompute for every bind: module paths, custody kinds, physical facts, policy roots and distribution provenance.
responsibilities: serve a module's resolved path only for the same module object (weak reference) and __file__, or, with no module object, the same sys.path
serve a path's custody kind under the same user, environment and site roots
serve a physical module's facts only for the same module object, resolved path and file (mtime_ns, size)
serve resolved policy roots per raw input and interpreter state, and distribution maps and provenance per site-root signature
bound each map LRU at _MAX_ENTRIES under one class RLock; never hold a module, source text, AST or result
